headline: Mueller Water Products Boosts Share Buyback by $300M and Raises Dividend
summary: Mueller Water Products announced a $300 million expansion of its share repurchase authorization alongside an increase to its quarterly dividend payout.
why: Mueller Water Products is a leading manufacturer of water infrastructure and flow control products for municipal and industrial markets.

impacts.name: Mueller Water Products Inc
impacts.why: Expanded share buybacks and higher dividends signal strong cash flows and return capital directly to shareholders.

why_moved: Announcements of expanded share buyback programs and dividend increases signal strong capital returns, often lifting share prices.
